name: Restore Mind
originalText:
#### Restore Mind

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Unhinge the Mind
- **Source Page:** 4

```text
Target One creature other than you that you can see within
short range
You must concentrate for 1 hour, during which time your
mind enters the target’s mind. A target that moves beyond
short range breaks your concentration and the effect ends. If
you concentrate for the full time, choose one of the following
effects.
• Remove 1d6 Insanity from the target.
• A target with a long-term madness can make a Will
challenge roll. On a success, the target moves down
two stages (minimum stage 0).
```
